global_style: Elegant Morandi-style template featuring organic background blobs, soft drop shadows, paper-cut botanical elements, and a serene, layered aesthetic.

identity_anchors: Muted Morandi color palette with fluid, organic background shapes
Large, heavily rounded central white content cards with soft outer drop shadows
Overlapping paper-cut style lavender botanical sprigs and leaves
Dangling decorative circular tags suspended from the top edge
Delicate, continuous line-art botanical illustrations used as overlays

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
